_what_this_is: One row per master material, each at a rung of the stage ladder from Docs/37_POLISH_PASS_PROCESS.md. The point is to get MANY assets to 50% and review them together at S2, rather than finishing one at a time at S3 where moving it is expensive.
_status: SEEDED EMPTY. Nobody has triaged these yet. Every stage and priority below is null on purpose.
_do_not: Do not fill this in to make a gate go green. A stage is a claim about where an asset actually is, made by someone who has looked at it.

_stage_ladder.S0: MEASURE - instruments exist; numbers recorded at a named commit
_stage_ladder.S1: BLOCKOUT - cheap placeholder geometry; massing, metrics, sightlines. Free, delete and rebuild
_stage_ladder.S2: ART-BLOCKOUT - real shapes, palette, materials by eye. No UV, no texture. Cheap, still blockout underneath
_stage_ladder.S3: ASSET PRODUCTION - unwrap, texture, final materials, LODs. Expensive
_stage_ladder.S4: DRESS - prop placement, clutter, set dressing. Expensive, and placement is coupled to scale
_stage_ladder.S5: FEEL TUNE - movement, camera, timing, juice. Cheap per change, expensive to re-baseline

_how_to_fill: 1. For each master: look at it, then set stage to the rung it has actually reached. 'S2' or 'S2 ART-BLOCKOUT' both work.
2. Set priority. This is the ordering you want to review in, and it is what makes batching work - the point is a batch at S2, not a queue.
3. Stage must be one of S0..S5. Anything else is rejected rather than counted, so a typo cannot read as a declared state.
4. Nothing else in this file is read by the gate.
_note_on_the_two_failing_materials: M_FamilySilhouette and M_ValleyNight are NOT on this list. They are not one of the ten masters, they fail env.master_binding, and the Lead has ruled they stay RED for the art pass.
